sourceTitle.en: 2024 Republican Party Platform, “Make America Great Again!” (PDF, undated; adopted by the RNC Platform Committee July 8, 2024, per the GOP press release of that date)

summary.en: The party’s 2024 national platform. The PDF carries no date. The GOP press release of July 8, 2024 says the RNC Platform Committee adopted it that day. The lines shown here come from that document.

whyIncluded.en: One of the two parties with members in Congress on every midterm ballot.
